name: Robust Mesh Voxelization via Exact Predicates
definition: A function that takes a Piecewise Linear Complex (PLC) and options, and produces a VoxelGrid containing an occupancy grid and/or a signed-distance field (SDF).
summary: Robust Mesh Voxelization via Exact Predicates is a mesh-native voxelizer that uses Shewchuk's exact geometric predicates to ensure watertight, artifact-free occupancy grids and signed-distance fields without epsilon-based ray casting artifacts.
